# SRD 5.2.1 System JSON

> Machine-readable JSON-LD 1.1 reference corpus for the System Reference Document 5.2.1, with JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation. 2,226 records preserve source wording, typed indexes, graph links, and physical line provenance.

Attribution: This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (“SRD 5.2.1”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd. The SRD 5.2.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, available at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.

## Entry points

- [Human-readable explorer](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/)
- [Full corpus context](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/llms-full.txt): complete recursive text projection
- [Aggregate manifest](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/srd52-system-data.jsonld): collection membership, schemas, and digests
- [Single-file bundle](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/srd52-system-data.bundle.jsonld): all records in one @graph
- [Search index](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/search-index.json): static inverted token index
- [Collection index](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/collection-index.json): compact browse metadata
- [JSON-LD context](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/systems/context.jsonld)
- [Vocabulary terms](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/vocab/terms.json)

## Collections

Raw records use `objects/<collection>/<slug>.jsonld`; indexable HTML counterparts use `records/<collection>/<slug>/`. Every HTML page declares its JSON-LD alternate, and every JSON-LD record carries `htmlPage`.

- sources: 1 Source record
- rules: 708 Rule records
- actions: 12 Action records
- areas-of-effect: 6 AreaOfEffect records
- attitudes: 3 Attitude records
- hazards: 5 Hazard records
- tables: 224 Table records
- classes: 12 CharacterClass records
- subclasses: 12 Subclass records
- invocations: 28 EldritchInvocation records
- metamagic-options: 10 MetamagicOption records
- species: 9 Species records
- backgrounds: 4 Background records
- feats: 17 Feat records
- equipment: 227 Equipment records
- spells: 339 Spell records
- conditions: 15 Condition records
- magic-items: 258 MagicItem records
- monsters: 336 Monster records

Typed relations include `listsSpell`, `castsSpell`, `mentionsCondition`, `grantsFeat`, `hasGear`, `summons`, `areaShapes`, `grantsTool`, `grantsEquipment`, `relatedRules`, `relatedTables`, `seeAlso`, and catalog `hasPart` links. Core incoming directions have JSON-LD `@reverse` aliases.
